title: Drafting Agents, Not Just Tokens: Speculative Recursive Self-Improvement for Agentic Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.16491v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Improving an agent through successive revisions requires balancing exploration and evaluation under a limited budget. A narrow search can miss useful sequences of edits, while fully evaluating every intermediate version can exhaust the budget before those sequences yield a verified improvement. We introduce Speculative Recursive Self-Improvement (SpecRSI), which drafts executable successor agents before their predecessors are fully evaluated, while requiring complete verification before adoption. Verification-Aware Tree Search (VATS) allocates the budget between further edits and outstanding checks using the predicted verified return of a continuation. Group Verification Optimization (GVO) learns the improver from completed searches while keeping the real evaluator fixed. translated_title: 起草智能体，而不仅仅是令牌：面向智能体系统的推测性递归自我改进
translated_abstract: 通过连续修订来改进一个智能体，需要在有限预算下平衡探索与评估。狭窄的搜索可能遗漏有用的编辑序列，而对每个中间版本进行完整评估则可能在这些序列产生经验证的改进之前就耗尽预算。我们提出了推测性递归自我改进，它在完整评估前驱版本之前就起草可执行的后续智能体，同时要求在正式采用之前进行完整验证。验证感知树搜索利用对某个延续的预测验证回报，在进一步的编辑与待完成的检查之间分配预算。组验证优化则从已完成的搜索中学习改进器，同时保持真实评估器固定不变。在主要的科学对比中，终端收益超过Janus方法33.3%--40.0%。额外的评估显示，SpecRSI在全部50个科学基准上均优于Janus。
tldr: 提出SpecRSI框架，在完整评估前驱版本之前就起草可执行的后续智能体，并结合验证感知树搜索与组验证优化，在有限预算下实现推测性递归自我改进，终端收益超过Janus方法33.3%至40.0%。
en_tdlr: SpecRSI drafts executable successor agents before fully evaluating predecessors, combining Verification-Aware Tree Search with Group Verification Optimization to enable speculative recursive self-improvement under a limited budget, surpassing Janus by 33.3%–40.0% in terminal gains.
